# Amos Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 335r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/AMO_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-words [divrei] of-Amos [Amos], who was among the-herdsmen [noqdim] of-Teqoa [Tekoa], which he-saw [chazah] concerning Yisra'el in-the-days of-Uzziyyah [Uzziah] king of-Yehudah [Judah] and-in-the-days of-Yarov'am [Jeroboam] son of-Yo'ash [Joash] king of-Yisra'el, two-years [shenatayim] before the-earthquake [ha-ra'ash].

**1:2** And-he-said: "YHWH from-Tsiyon [Zion] roars [yish'ag], and-from-Yerushalayim [Jerusalem] gives [yitten] his-voice [qolo]; and-the-pastures [ne'ot] of-the-shepherds [ha-ro'im] mourn [ve'avlu], and-the-top [rosh] of-the-Karmel [Carmel] withers [veyavesh]."

**1:3** Thus says YHWH: "For three transgressions [pish'ei] of-Dammeseq [Damascus], and-for four [arba'ah], I-will-not turn-it-back [lo ashivennu] — because they-threshed [dusham] Gil'ad [Gilead] with-threshing-sledges [bacharutsot] of-iron [ha-barzel]."

**1:4** "And-I-will-send [veshillachti] fire [esh] on-the-house of-Chaza'el [Hazael], and-it-will-devour [ve'akhelah] the-fortresses [armenot] of-Ben-Hadad."

**1:5** "And-I-will-break [veshabbarti] the-bar [beriach] of-Dammeseq, and-cut-off [vehikhrati] the-inhabitant [yoshev] from-Biq'at-Aven [Valley of Aven], and-the-one-who-holds [tomekh] the-scepter [shevet] from-Beit-Eden [Beth-Eden]; and-the-people [am] of-Aram will-go-into-exile [vegalu] to-Qir [Kir]," says YHWH.

**1:6** Thus says YHWH: "For three transgressions of-Azzah [Gaza], and-for four, I-will-not turn-it-back — because they-carried-into-exile [haglotam] a-complete [shelemah] exile [galut] to-hand-over [lehasgir] to-Edom."

**1:7** "And-I-will-send fire on-the-wall [chomat] of-Azzah, and-it-will-devour her-fortresses."

**1:8** "And-I-will-cut-off the-inhabitant from-Ashdod, and-the-holder of-the-scepter from-Ashqelon [Ashkelon]; and-I-will-turn [vahashivoti] my-hand [yadi] against Eqron [Ekron], and-the-remnant [she'erit] of-the-Pelishtim [Philistines] will-perish [ve'avdu]," says the-Lord [Adonai] YHWH.

**1:9** Thus says YHWH: "For three transgressions of-Tsor [Tyre], and-for four, I-will-not turn-it-back — because they-handed-over [hasggiram] a-complete exile to-Edom, and-did-not remember [lo zakhru] the-covenant [berit] of-brothers [achim]."

**1:10** "And-I-will-send fire on-the-wall of-Tsor, and-it-will-devour her-fortresses."

**1:11** Thus says YHWH: "For three transgressions of-Edom, and-for four, I-will-not turn-it-back — because he-pursued [rodfo] with-the-sword [ba-cherev] his-brother [achiv], and-destroyed [shichet] his-compassion [rachamav], and-his-anger [appo] tore [yitrop] perpetually [la-ad], and-his-fury [evreto] he-kept [shemarah] forever [netsach]."

**1:12** "And-I-will-send fire on-Teman, and-it-will-devour the-fortresses of-Botsrah [Bozrah]."

**1:13** Thus says YHWH: "For three transgressions of-the-sons of-Ammon, and-for four, I-will-not turn-it-back — because they-ripped-open [biq'am] the-pregnant-women [harot] of-Gil'ad in-order-to enlarge [harchiv] their-border [gevulam]."

**1:14** "And-I-will-kindle [vehitstsati] fire on-the-wall of-Rabbah, and-it-will-devour her-fortresses, with-shouting [bi-teru'ah] on-the-day of-battle [milchamah], with-a-storm [be-sa'ar] on-the-day of-tempest [sufah]."

**1:15** "And-their-king [malkam] will-go into-exile [galut], he and-his-princes [sarav] together [yachdav]," says YHWH.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "among the herdsmen":** *Noqdim* — a rare word, occurring only here and in 2 Kings 3:4 (of Mesha king of Moab). It likely means "sheep-breeder" rather than simple "shepherd." Amos was not merely poor — he was a livestock professional.

**v.1 — "the earthquake":** A seismic event c. 760 BCE significant enough to be remembered generations later (cf. Zechariah 14:5). Archaeological evidence of a major earthquake has been found at Hazor and other sites.

**v.3 — "for three... and for four":** The x/x+1 numerical pattern is a wisdom formula (cf. Proverbs 30:15-31). It implies "for transgression upon transgression" — the list is full, the judgment inevitable.

*— EMET*
